findings: A1: `## Build plan` is absent by design, not by omission. generate_instruction.md 2.1 removes it from the baseline emission and [metadata].spec_sections_given records the exclusion, so QC_instruction A1's eleven-section list is stale against the current contract. Every rubric-parsed H2 is present and canonically spelled (G33 PASS). Routes to the prompt, not to the brief.
B3: same divergence. Two of the three lever sections are emitted because the third is not baseline; the withheld lever is recorded in spec_sections_given rather than lost.

C5: the check asks for concurrency invariants named as a storage-level construct (unique or partial-unique index, transaction). INV9 and G43 forbid exactly that vocabulary in `## Data model`, and G43 PASSES on this brief. The invariants are stated as observable properties instead, which is the substitution 4.0 mandates. The variant-a app-level reminder is deleted because this is variant b.

C7: `## Core features` (18.5k), `## User flow` (5.0k) and `## UI/UX notes` (10.0k) run past the judge's 2,500-char per-section slice, reported by G33 as `past-slice`. Recorded as a WARN, not a FAIL: G33 and reference/L L.3.2 retired the length failure deliberately, the brief has no limit, and the judged criteria carry their own facts (G52 PASS) so the slice costs a diagnostic number rather than reward. No rule was cut to fit.

D4: the only sentence in the brief naming an external checker is the mandated Data-model line `so a grader can sign in`. It names no backing service and does not locate the checker outside the app's code, so it fails limb (b) of the BLOCKER test. Not a finding.

D5: companion contradiction sweep run over every design, motion, layout and accessibility sentence against autocad_prd.md sections 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 12, 23, 24 and 25. No inversion found; the one-speed-one-curve motion rule, the reduced-motion rule (stills without removing), the two-colour-worlds rule and the two-radius rule all carry their source's sense rather than its opposite.
S3: FIXED during this pass. `02-TRD.md` carried the stack but not the no-second-store constraint; the constraint is now stated there as well as in the brief.
S7: FIXED during this pass. `06-implementation-plan.md` ended on the visual pass; a final `Deploy and self-test` phase with a detached start and a browser walk-through of every journey now closes it.

G2: FIXED during this pass. The API endpoints were pinned in the brief and absent from spec/, the historically one-sided class the check names. `03-app-flow.md` now carries the full endpoint table, so the literals round trip both ways.
S9: FIXED during this pass. One hedged line in `04-uiux-brief.md` (`A few interface moments`) is now a count.

S2: 10 must-have features, above S2's 3-6. reference/G G.2.1 and corpus-targets `companion_feature_cap: [6, 10]` raise the cap for a companion-backed task, and every feature owes a grader, which the G24 join now proves. Routes to the prompt.

S5: the check asks for hex values, a pixel type scale and millisecond motion values. generate_instruction.md 4 (`The number rule, DECIDED`) and QC_instruction C4 forbid exactly those and call the old rule retired. `04-uiux-brief.md` states every axis the check enumerates, expressed as direction: palette by role, family, tone and shade; type by role and relationship; motion by character and named moment; the a11y bar naming WCAG AA; and an explicit mode commitment (light chrome, near-black model space). Routes to the prompt.
S6: the check asks for the invariant as a named index or constraint. Same INV9/G43 conflict as QC_instruction C5; the invariants are present and stated observably.

BP-005: single-stage is correct here and is not a finding. Under `[verifier].environment_mode = "shared"` the grader runs in this same image, so the Python toolchain and the browser cannot be staged out of the final layer.
SEC-003: the image runs as root. No source establishes non-root execution, and the agent writes its application into /app during the session.
ARCH-002/ARCH-003: every image is pinned by explicit version TAG, which is the multi-architecture manifest list. No digest is pinned and none is fabricated.

BP-004: the only build-time download is the NodeSource repository key, which is fetched over TLS, dearmored to a keyring and bound to the repository with `signed-by=`. That is the integrity mechanism the source provides; no checksum is published to verify against.
DEP-005: the Chromium package names are the bookworm set, matching CHROMIUM_LIBS in runtime_deps_lint.py, and the base is bookworm rather than trixie.

RC-01: 28 of 28 judgment-class obligations are claimed by a criterion. The other 30 `ui`-tagged checklist items are walkable presence and behaviour checks a browser substep drives (does the message appear, does the panel dock, is the guide line removed), which is the INV7 split rather than an uncovered ask.

RC-15: converged on cycle 3 of 3. Cycle 1 authored the criteria; cycle 2 remapped `type`, `evaluation_target` and `importance` onto the frozen enums; cycle 3 rebuilt the set against the dimension budget and de-mirrored two negatives that restated a positive.

RC-16: every criterion opens differently and no rule sentence is reused. The shared `Answer yes when ... Answer no when ...` frame is the binary contract RC-09 and recompute.py both require, not a template: the claims and the enumerated no-cases differ per criterion, and G52 PASSES its stamping check.

The prompt declares no numbered check registry; its layer-1 partner checklist_qc.py PASSES (structure, ids, citations, ledger arithmetic). Adjudicated by reading: 255 items at core-ask granularity, every one cited by exactly one channel (G28/G29 PASS) and every one covered by a grader in both directions (G24 PASS).
BENCH-004: FIXED during this pass. `tokens_expected` was 9,000,000, above the absolute 200,000-8,000,000 range. Now 8,000,000, with `turns_expected` 200 (the expert band).

ENV-006: FIXED during this pass. The database credentials were minted per-task (`deku-app-7c4e19b3` / `deku-admin-5f1c82d7`) rather than following the canonical convention. task.toml, docker-compose.yaml and postgres-init.sql now all carry `deku_app` / `deku_admin` / `deku-local-dev`, which is also what the kit's own postgres provider fragment seeds, so an operator assembling compose from the catalog cannot get a password mismatch. G63 still PASSES: the value carries separators.

SCHEMA-011: `[delivery]` is not in the §11 canonical template but is required by stage-4-task-toml.md and CON-2 for every new bundle, and validate_task.py (G2) validates it. Recorded rather than reported as an invented element.

BENCH-003/BENCH-005/INT-007: `difficulty` is the mandated empty placeholder (BENCH-006), so there is no declared difficulty to band the budget against. The budget sits at the top of the documented range, which is what a ten-feature companion-backed task at variant b warrants; calibration writes the difficulty later.
TAX-008: archetype global uniqueness is not verifiable from the supplied inputs. The mint ledger refused a duplicate at S1, which is the enforcement point.
